digest.component_or_area: store event writing and ticket directory creation
propositions: os.makedirs(ticket_dir) executed outside the write lock before the first event file was written, leaving a race window where an interruption (kill, timeout, host sleep) creates an empty ticket directory that persists undetected by concurrent writers

the existing ticket scanners (MISSING_CREATE check and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH list) already skip dot-prefixed top-level entries, so staging directories named .tmp-newticket-* are invisible to fsck without requiring scanner changes
StagedEvent.promote() publishes the directory and its first event together via a single os.rename() call executed under the existing write lock, eliminating the vulnerable window

sweep_stale_staging() removes only writer-owned staging directories (.tmp-newticket-*) with provably dead owners using process start-time stamps to defeat pid recycling, respecting the 043f boundary that rejects cleanup of store data
batch_stage_and_commit and inbound_translate._write_event_file and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission are converted to use the same atomic staging and promote pattern
the fix preserves byte parity: canonical event serialization is unchanged and routed through the same serializer, so no event format or committed layout changes
